headline: 愛丁堡藝穗喜劇評論
context: 愛丁堡藝穗節喜劇評論持續發燒。喜劇團體 Sheeps 成員、《週六夜現場》英國版（Saturday Night Live UK）首席編劇達倫·強森（Daran "Jonno" Johnson），38歲首度推出個人單口喜劇《Here Comes Mr Funny》，評論形容這是他今年藝穗節最好笑的演出之一。美國喜劇演員艾比·葛文丹（Abby Govindan）的《Pushing 30》，則以詼諧口吻探討南亞文化中的婚姻壓力。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Monkey Barrel, Edinburgh The Saturday Night Live UK writer, who is one-third of the sketch troupe Sheeps, balances sincerity and shtick in a show with big laughs There are reasons to take up standup, and then there’s Daran “Jonno” Johnson launching this new career aged 38 as a form of exposure therapy for anxiety. At least we have an explanation for why this prodigiously funny and talented man hasn’t gone solo before. As one-third of the sketch-group-of-their-generation, Sheeps , and now head writer on the hit Saturday Night Live UK , he doesn’t lack credentials for a tilt at standup. And, while Here Comes Mr Funny has its teething problems, it’s a bright start to Jonno’s singular life, and gave me some of my biggest laughs of this fringe. What’s surprising about it, and arguably part of what works least well, is that Jonno – a man hitherto hidden behind tiers of irony in his performing career – reveals so much of himself. He admits to being nervous. He talks about envying watching his peers on TV, half expecting to see himself appear on screen and join them. Continue reading...
sources.title: Jonno: Here Comes Mr Funny review – Sheeps comic leaves flock for revelatory solo

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Pleasance Courtyard, Edinburgh Govindan’s debut takes aim at patriarchal stereotypes with pranks, PowerPoint and easygoing storytelling In south Asian culture, marriage continues to be paramount, with women still largely bearing the brunt of this societal pressure. Tonight, the few south Asian women in the audience that US comedian Abby Govindan calls upon – myself included – verify this, one explaining how her parents have given up now that she is in her mid-30s. For Govindan, who is nearing 30, it’s a familiar conversation she has had with well-meaning relatives, and one that creates an internal paradox. While she loves her south Asian identity and her Indian heritage, it can be difficult to reconcile this with the patriarchal stereotypes and archaic values that tend to hold women back. Continue reading...
sources.title: Abby Govindan: Pushing 30 review – playful comic makes the case for marriage as a side quest

愛丁堡藝穗節喜劇評論持續發燒。喜劇團體 Sheeps 成員、《週六夜現場》英國版首席編劇達倫·強森（Daran "Jonno" Johnson），38歲首度推出個人單口喜劇《Here Comes Mr Funny》。評論形容這是他這次藝穗節最好笑的演出之一，他也罕見地在台上坦承自己會緊張、會嫉妒同輩上電視。

美國喜劇演員艾比·葛文丹（Abby Govindan）的《Pushing 30》，以詼諧口吻探討南亞文化裡的婚姻壓力；接近30歲的她，透過與台下南亞裔觀眾的互動，聊起長輩對婚姻的期待。

voice_text: 愛丁堡藝穗節的喜劇評論，這幾天一則接一則。先說達倫·強森，他是喜劇團體 Sheeps 的成員，也是《週六夜現場》英國版的首席編劇，38歲才第一次做個人單口喜劇，作品叫《Here Comes Mr Funny》。評論說這是他這次藝穗節最好笑的演出之一，他還在台上坦承自己會緊張、會嫉妒同輩上電視。同一個藝穗節裡，美國喜劇演員艾比·葛文丹的《Pushing 30》，用詼諧的口吻聊南亞文化裡的婚姻壓力。她自己快30歲了，透過跟台下觀眾互動，聊起長輩對婚姻的期待。
